newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Newcrest says Telfer hit by rain.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Newcrest says Telfer hit by rain.

text.p: Newcrest Mining Ltd said on Monday that mining activities at its Telfer gold operation in Western Australia had been temporarily suspended due to persistent heavy rain.
"It will not be possible to quantify the full year impact of the rain on Telfer until after production resumes," the company said.
The company said on February 5 that eight weeks of heavy rain had prevented road access and that activities would be scaled-down for at least two weeks.
In its latest statement, Newcrest said mining activities had now been progressively scaled back and all non-essential activities suspended.

"Some gold production will be maintained through the continuing irrigation of the leach dumps," it said. "Gold production was marginally affected in January. February production is expected to be more substantially affected."
